note.text: After installing/reinstalling 5.3.2 and restarting the app, the resumed conversation's workspace-reader.status still omitted final_review_protocol. The new 5.3.2 workflow correctly failed closed before assess_risk/plan: zero clean iterations accepted, no reviewers launched, delivery blocked. This demonstrates the stale-runtime handshake works. The remaining runtime refresh requires a genuinely new Codex thread because the MCP connection is conversation-bound; reopening this thread preserves the old connection.
